text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During lunch break, I spotted
Copano Rickey and the others talking in the cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: —So, what did you want to consult us about, Acute-san?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, I received a letter the other day.
Sent to the academy via "electronic mail."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It seems to be from someone abroad. They happened
to see me at the racetrack while traveling and wrote in.
I'm truly grateful for it.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~! That's so nice!
Connections crossing borders like that are so dreamy!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to write back if possible,
but I'm not really familiar with interacting with folks overseas.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Could we see the email?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, I had it translated and sent to me.
Would you like to take a look?

text_block_list.name: Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Events running on such massive racetracks
were completely unfamiliar in my country."

text_block_list.name: Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Racing is still far from mainstream here,
let alone the culture of live performances."

text_block_list.name: Letter
text_block_list.text:
"—If only I could share that powerful running
and gentle singing voice with everyone in my country."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like Horse Girl racing isn't very big in their country.
And yet you captivated them... That's amazing.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, attached at the end by the name,
looks like an SNS account!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ooh... They've got quite a few followers!
Looks like they do streaming and stuff, too.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: If only I were better with "SNS" myself...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! Yin-Yang and the Four Symbols, all things are connected!
Feelings can be conveyed through a person's qi♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Even with the dragon veins across the ocean,
as long as the people's feelings generating qi grow strong, they can connect!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
For that, I think it's important to synchronize
the qi of the sender and the receiver.
Something that can unite our feelings—
choice_data_list: How about pioneering new fans with your running?
How about building on the concert that brought them comfort?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Right, totally!
If seeing her run was the spark,
then building on that is the absolute best way!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
We've gotta gather lots of people to help!
I'll go call everyone over~!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'll handle the arrangements for video production and such.
If we're doing this on campus, we might also need permission from the student council just in case.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, this sounds like it's going to turn into
quite a lively project.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
All right! And so, officially endorsed by Tracen Academy,
welcome to the "Academy Showcase Channel"!
Today, we have a mock race special!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Turf or dirt, sprint, mile, or medium-long distance!
You'll get to watch thrilling races just like the real deal♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
We're so lucky they let us use
the academy's streaming account!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was so eager to take part, too.
I'm truly grateful.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Looks like lots of comments from overseas viewers
are starting to roll in.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Since we contacted them beforehand, that fan of Acute-san
must have helped promote it.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yup, yup! When you circulate positive yang qi like that,
things just naturally work out!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Then I'll have to do my best
to show them my finest side.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All right! Let's show off a great run
and connect the whole world with positive qi!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: It feels a bit embarrassing, though.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, Acute-san.
You're looking absolutely wonderful on camera.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Students who are great at video editing helped out too,
so I'm glad we could make such great footage♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Even in countries where racing culture isn't mainstream,
I'm sure its charm will get through!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Because the way we run has the incredible power
to make anyone's heart race!♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
A live performance... Yeah, that makes sense.
From the sound of that letter, even Winning Lives
weren't familiar to them.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I agree with Trainer.
It also makes for great video content♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All right! Let's gather as many helpers
as we can! The more the merrier for things like this!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu.
Sounds like it's going to be lots of fun.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later. With the help of many student volunteers,
production on the special live performance began—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All riiight♪
Next up, it's the three of us:
me, Tarumae, and Acute-san! Let's gooo!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Getting to sing this much in one day
almost feels like a luxury...♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
We're so lucky even the academy
cooperated with us!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The only reason the academy helped out was because
you got way too excited recruiting participants, Rickey.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yup, yup! When lots of people gather together,
we can accomplish big things!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The surge of positive yang qi doesn't just dispel negativity,
I'm sure it also connects people's hearts♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later. Together with student volunteers,
filming for the live performance video took place—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I hope this gives people a chance
to learn about our lives and races.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It definitely will!
Everyone helped out with filming, video editing,
and even translating the lyrics for overseas viewers!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The positive yang qi Acute-san radiates
makes everyone feel optimistic.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure the person who wrote the letter
will feel that sentiment when watching this video too♪
